n1-newskill#14.name: newskill-create-error
n1-newskill#14.fix_plan: Delete the MANIFEST_VALIDATION_FAILED branch from formatCreateSkillError (WelcomePage.tsx:180-185, the function that maps a create error to user copy) so only OS-level codes remain (SKILL_ALREADY_EXISTS :174-176, INVALID_DIRECTORY_PATH :177-179) plus the errorMessage fallback at :186. Rationale: submitNewSkill now catches a plain Rust error STRING (e.g. 'Cannot create a new skill in a non-empty folder: ...', native_fs.rs:1740) — Rust emits NO structured error_code, so studioErrorPayload(error) (WelcomePage.tsx:103-108, requires error.response.data) returns null and every error_code branch is UNREACHABLE on the create path; the error already falls through to errorMessage(error) (errors.ts:92-119) which returns the raw Rust string. So behavior is already green (no manifest/lint copy can surface on create), but the design's explicit source cleanup (remove the dead MANIFEST branch) is NOT done — the branch and its lint helpers are still in source. Note: the lint helpers firstLintErrorMessage/cleanLintMessage/relativeLintFile/lineFromLintMessage (WelcomePage.tsx:114-160) are ALSO used by formatImportSkillError (:205,:207, the Open-folder path, a different page's scope), so they cannot be fully removed by this page alone — only the create branch is removed here. Also update the obsolete tests WelcomePage.test.tsx:281-318 that still assert formatCreateSkillError emits lint copy.
